name: slate
description: Plan, write and voice films with Slate, and start renders, QA and delivery as background jobs on this Mac.
long_description:
Slate is a film studio any agent can run: brief, script, voice, motion, sound, QA and delivery, every stage gated by a machine check.

This extension lets a regular Claude chat use the Slate installed on this Mac. It can check where a film stands, start a new one from your request, write and build the script, voice it, and start renders, QA sweeps, review packets and delivery as background jobs that keep running after the chat moves on.

It carries no Slate code of its own: it starts the `slate` command you installed, so chat and command line always agree. Install Slate first (one command, in the README). Stages that spend credits ask you first, and After Effects steps, approvals and budgets stay yours, in your own terminal.

slate_command.title: Slate command
slate_command.description: Where the slate command is. Slate's installer links it into ~/.local/bin.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Where a film stands: every stage fresh, stale, missing or locked, and the one next command to run.

tools.name: new_film
tools.description: Start a film folder from a request: the brief (the request word for word, with its checklist), a script skeleton and the stage folders, in the films folder.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run one stage and return its result.

tools.name: job_submit
tools.description: Queue a long stage as a background job and get its id at once; it keeps running whoever started it.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: One job's state, attempt, reason and log path; without a job id, the queue at a glance and the recent jobs.

tools.name: job_log
tools.description: The end of a job's log.

tools.name: job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job.

tools.name: script_get
tools.description: The film's script/script.json: the one hand-edited script file (acts of shots with vo, on_screen, picture and source).

tools.name: script_put
tools.description: Write the film's whole script/script.json, checked against its schema, then lint it and return the gates.

tools.name: budget
tools.description: This month's spend against the caps for each mode, and each film's budget.

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Every paid call Slate made, newest first; the calls still in flight; or how the ledger squares with the vendors' balance snapshots (reconcile).

tools.name: balance_snapshot
tools.description: Record a vendor's balance in Slate's ledger: one Slate reads itself, or one read from a connector or dashboard.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: Slate's reference guides, read straight from its skills: without a topic, the list of topics; with one, the file itself.
